User.title: User
User.description: A user of the SizerSathi application.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user (Auth UID).

isVerified.description: Whether the user's email is verified.

UploadedDocument.title: UploadedDocument
UploadedDocument.description: A document uploaded by a user.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the document.

type.description: The type of document (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Photo, Signature).

fileName.description: The name of the uploaded file.

fileSize.description: The size of the uploaded file.

uploadDate.description: The date the file was uploaded.

mimeType.description: The mime type of the file.

VerifiedProfile.title: VerifiedProfile
VerifiedProfile.description: A verified profile of a user.

fullName.description: The full name of the user.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the user.

fatherName.description: The father's name of the user.

aadhaarNumber.description: The Aadhaar number of the user.

panNumber.description: The PAN number of the user.

/users/{userId}.description: The collection of users. Indexed by user ID.

/users/{userId}/profile/verified.description: The verified profile of the user.
